new_libraries.name: SmoothUI
new_libraries.author: Oshan Dissanayaka
new_libraries.sentence: Smooth, animated menus for OLED and TFT displays: menus, lists, switches, sliders, choices, time pickers, timers, alerts and progress screens.
new_libraries.paragraph: One library for SSD1306/SH1106 OLEDs and ST7735/ST7789/ILI9341 TFTs - pick your display by uncommenting one line. Rows unfold, the selection glides and stretches, pages slide, long text scrolls. Works with a rotary encoder or push buttons. Built on Adafruit GFX.

library.name: LynkTuyaLocal
library.author: Alex Fichter
library.sentence: Control Tuya devices from ESP32 over the local network, without the Tuya cloud.
library.paragraph: Implements the Tuya LAN protocol v3.4 and v3.5 directly over TCP: authentication handshake, session key generation, AES-ECB/HMAC-SHA256 (v3.4) and AES-GCM (v3.5) encryption, status requests and power on/off commands. Use TinyTuya to obtain the device IP and Local Key.
